content.text: Skip to main content Graduate Admission A Great Location Minutes From Boston A Hub for International Business. A Home for Big Ideas. Waltham, Massachusetts is Bentley’s hometown. It’s a vibrant community with lively eating, arts and shopping options for every taste. Bentley is also minutes from Boston, where the world’s most recognized companies come for the city’s world-class universities, innovative industries and economic vitality. Students come from all over the world for our vibrant culture, rich history and diverse professional opportunities. Visit Bentley Maps & Directions Bentley University is located at 175 Forest Street, Waltham, MA 02452. Situated on 163 acres, the Bentley campus offers the best of both worlds: a safe, suburban campus with ready access to Boston, the largest college town in the country. If you are looking to visit our campus, there are multiple ways to get here depending on your mode of transportation. There are also a myriad of local hotel accommodations available for your visit and certainly plenty to do in the greater Waltham and Boston area. Learn More Work Live Play Innovation Meets Opportunity. Boston leads the country in visionary research and world-renowned education, creating a dynamic environment for innovation across sectors. Companies Started In And Around Boston: Converse, Dunkin Donuts, New Balance, Fidelity, Staples, TJX Companies, TripAdvisor, Gillette, Boston Beer Company, Boston Scientific Largest Companies Based In Boston: GE, Liberty Mutual, State Street, American Tower, LPL Financial Holdings, Iron Mountain, Cabot, Boston Properties, Wayfair The Heart of New England. Bentley is minutes from many of Boston's most sought-after neighborhoods and innovation centers offering students options that blend urban life with the natural beauty of our Waltham campus. An Inspired Way Of Life. From the fine arts to Fenway Park, Boston's unique spirit matches professional opportunities and connections for any career with culture and recreation for any lifestyle. Massachusetts is a Great State to Live Massachusetts consistently ranks as a top place to live in the U.S. One recent ranking, WalletHub, based its ranking on 51 "key indicators of livability." Massachusetts ranked first in education and health, while also getting high rankings for quality of life, safety, and its economy.
